dataset_access: gated; requires authenticated HF account that accepted the terms
label_map: lossy; categories without a counterpart were dropped (Financial Services, Income, Government & Legal, Charity & Donations)
protocol_caveats: The 20,000 rows are the first slice of the split, not a random sample.
Every row is evaluated as debit / amount 100.0 / merchant None; the public schema has no equivalent fields here.
No per-class or macro-F1 metrics were computed.
caveats: Out-of-distribution signal only, not a benchmark: the public label taxonomy does not match this project's ten categories.
The dataset card is MIT-labelled but mixes synthetic and unnamed external sources.
The model was trained on this project's own synthetic merchants; this is the first non-synthetic-ish check, not proof of real-statement accuracy.
